originality.rationale: The exact nonuniform Brodlie mesh-ratio coefficient and its necessary-and-sufficient grid condition were compared at statement and implication level with the full original 1984 Fritsch–Butland paper, an accessible 2019 Brodlie analysis, a full published uniform-harmonic variation theorem, and a separate published nonuniform Steffen theorem. The uniform theorem is a strict special case; the Steffen rule has different two-variable derivatives and a provably different local coefficient. The full 2013 nonuniform Aràndiga paper could not be inspected, and residual historical priority is qualified; no identified accessible stronger theorem implies the result.

value.rationale: Sharp perturbation sensitivity for a standard nonuniform shape-preserving cubic interpolation rule has natural numerical relevance distinct from individual-data monotonicity. The formula gives a complete necessary-and-sufficient mesh regularity condition, exact optimal coefficient on every fixed bi-infinite grid, rigorous sharpness mechanism and a genuine distinction from the existing nonuniform Steffen operator. These are structurally motivated all-grid results, not isolated routine calculations.
